settings.title: Pipelines and lost reasons
settings.description: Create a pipeline for each process, choose which teams see each one, and organize stages and lost reasons.

list.title: Pipelines
list.description: The default pipeline opens first in the Kanban and receives deals created without a pipeline.

create.title: New pipeline
create.description: The pipeline starts with the default stages, which you can adjust later.

teams.description: With no team selected, everyone sees the pipeline. Administrators always see every pipeline.

remove.title: Delete the pipeline {{name}}
remove.description: The pipeline and its stages will be permanently deleted.
remove.withDeals_one: The pipeline has {{count}} deal. Choose the pipeline and stages that will receive it.
remove.withDeals_other: The pipeline has {{count}} deals. Choose the pipeline and stages that will receive them.
remove.noTarget: There is no other active pipeline to receive the deals. Create or reactivate one first.
remove.noCompatible: No stage of the same kind

rules.entryDescription: A deal only enters this stage with these fields filled in.
rules.exitDescription: A deal only leaves this stage with these fields filled in.

errors.defaultPipelineRequired: The default pipeline cannot be deactivated or deleted, and an inactive pipeline cannot be the default. Choose another default pipeline first.
errors.pipelineHasDeals: The pipeline has deals. Choose a target pipeline to move them to.
errors.pipelineLimitReached: The organization reached the pipeline limit.

settings.title: Pipeline and lost reasons
settings.description: Organize the stages of the sales pipeline and the reasons used when a deal is lost.

errors.title: The change could not be made
errors.stageHasDeals: The stage has deals. Choose a target stage to move them to.
errors.closingStagesRequired: The pipeline must keep at least one active open, won and lost stage.
errors.lastLostReason: Keep at least one lost reason active.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Stages show in this order on the Kanban. Won and lost stages close the deal.
stages.dialogDescription: Set the name, the close probability and the kind of the stage.
stages.name: Name
stages.probabilityInvalid: Use a whole number between 0 and 100.
stages.kindLocked: The kind cannot change while the stage has deals.

removal.deactivateDescription: The stage leaves the Kanban and can be reactivated later.
removal.deleteDescription: The stage will be deleted for good.
removal.withDeals_one: The stage has {{count}} deal. Choose the stage it moves to.
removal.withDeals_other: The stage has {{count}} deals. Choose the stage they move to.
removal.noTarget: There is no other active stage of the same kind to receive the deals. Create one first.

lostReasons.title: Lost reasons
lostReasons.description: Reasons offered when a deal is marked as lost. Deactivate the ones you no longer use.
lostReasons.name: Reason name

editor.title: Stage guidance
editor.description: Guidance for the salesperson and the stage checklist. Required items must be done before the deal advances from this stage or is won.
editor.error: Could not save the stage guidance.
editor.conflict: The guidance was changed by someone else. Close and open the stage again.
editor.labelRequired: Fill in the text of every item.

panel.title: Guidance for {{stage}}
panel.empty: This stage has no guidance or checklist.

errors.checklistIncomplete: Complete the required items of the stage guidance before advancing: {{items}}.

placeholders.guidance: Guide the team on this stage

stage.label: Days before rotting
stage.description: Open deals that stay longer than this in the stage show up as rotting. Leave it empty for no limit.
stage.invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 3650 or leave it empty.

badge.title: Past the stage limit of {{limit}} days

filter.label: Rotting
filter.description: Show only deals rotting in their stage

placeholders.guidance: Guide the team on this stage
